source_obligation_rule: source_obligation marks an origin with an archive whose license expression matches GPL|MPL|Artistic; the upstream sources of every origin are vendored either way

attribution_method.scope: every regular member of each upstream tar archive (reading every gzip member, xz stream and bzip2 stream of the source), each upstream file that is not a tar archive (as one file), and each Alpine-local source file of the origin, each read to its end
attribution_method.line: the exact bytes of every line (split on LF) that contains the marker
attribution_method.field: escape_field: UTF-8 text as written, except that a backslash, tab, CR or LF becomes \\, \t, \r or \n, and a byte that is not UTF-8, each byte of a character in ESCAPED_CODE_POINTS (C0 and C1 controls, DEL, non-space separators, every Unicode 15.1 format character (category Cf, which includes the bidirectional controls), surrogates, noncharacters) and a trailing space become \xNN; the set is fixed here, not taken from the interpreter's Unicode database; unescape_field restores the exact bytes
attribution_method.gaps: a file whose first binary_probe_bytes hold a NUL byte is not scanned and is listed as a binary head; a file over max_member_bytes is not scanned and is listed as over the member limit; a line longer than max_line_bytes is not recorded, and when it carries the marker (searched across the whole line, including the part not held) its file is listed with the number of such lines; a member that holds data but is not a plain regular file (sparse, or of an unknown type) is not scanned and is listed as an unscanned member; a source whose decompressed stream holds anything but zero bytes after its tar archive ends, or that holds anything after an xz stream but stream padding (zero bytes, a multiple of four) and further streams, or anything after a bzip2 stream but further streams, a source over max_source_bytes, or a closure over max_total_bytes (the sizes of all members streamed) fails the check
